release_notes: Build 103 fixes the Archive completed C button so the new grouped physical-folder archive workflow opens directly instead of being intercepted by the older duplicate-path repair dialog.
The legacy global duplicate-path click gate is now disabled; its diagnostic repair code remains available but no longer blocks grouped C: to Z: archiving.

Shared C: project folders are handled by the Build 102 physical-folder archive engine: copy or reuse one verified Z: project, update every linked Quiz History row together, verify the database paths, then remove C: only after all checks pass.
Any linked History row with outstanding required uploads blocks the entire shared physical folder from moving.
Existing Z: folders are never overwritten or deleted and new archive collisions remain collision-safe.
A regression test now asserts that the legacy duplicate-path archive gate stays disabled.
